strategy.offer: An online mail-order catalog selling recorded music and related media in physical formats, plus books and merchandise, including both in-house and third-party releases.
strategy.customers: Collectors and enthusiasts of classic and roots-oriented popular music who want physical editions, catalog depth, and artist- or label-focused browsing.
strategy.why_we_win: It competes through broad yet curated selection, detailed product information, frequent new and discounted items, and one destination for many labels and formats.
strategy.resources: Its basis is an established online mail-order platform, an in-house label, deep catalog organization, and content-rich listings with track, format, and availability data.
